content: Ne, Papuru, nekanixewaɨritɨaka Kɨritsitu Ketsutsi hetsiemieme nemɨti'uximayatame, nemuta'inierie nɨ'ariekame nemayanikɨ, nemupatsie Kakaɨyari niukieya 'aixɨa manuyɨne nemukuxatanikɨ.
Meripaitɨ Kakaɨyari mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨkaitɨni temeixeiyanikekaikɨ, Kakaɨyari niukametemama yametekuxatakaku niuki mɨpatsietsie,
yuniwe xatatɨ, tewi hɨkɨtɨtɨ, nu'aya kaniutinuiwa Rawiri hetsie mɨyetɨa.
Mɨkite watsata manukukekɨ, tɨrɨkariyakɨ kaniukayerieni Kakaɨyari Nu'ayatɨtɨ, 'Iyari Kakaɨyaritsie mieme mɨtatsipata kemɨtikaye. Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu kanixatakaitɨni mɨtati'aitɨwame.
Mɨkɨkɨ 'aixɨa tepɨ'itɨarie mɨkɨ 'aixɨa tiuka'iyarikaku, tepeutanɨ'ariexɨata para yunaitɨ nuiwarite yuri mete'erietɨ yamemɨtekahunikɨ, kemɨtitewakɨ me'eyexeiyatɨ.
Xemeta nuiwarite xekanihɨkɨtɨni xemuta'inierie Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu teɨterimama xemakɨnekɨ.
Nekatinixe'uta'utɨirieni yunaime Xumatsie xemɨtama Kakaɨyari mɨxenaki'erie, xemuta'inierie hetsiena mieme xemɨpatsienikɨ.
Kakaɨyari mɨta'ukiyari meta Ti'aitame Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu, 'aixɨa mekete'u'iyarini xehetsiemieme, mekexepitɨaka yu'iyaritsie xemɨka'uximatɨariekakɨ.
Papuru kemɨti'iwatamɨkɨkai Xumatsie
Merikɨtsɨ Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu netsiparewiekaku pamɨpariyutsi nekanipitɨaka nekakaɨyari meri yunaime xehetsiemieme, naitsarie kwiepa mɨkuxaxatsiwakɨ yuri kexemɨte'erie.

Ne'iyarikɨ Kakaɨyari hetsiemieme nepɨti'uximaya, niuki nu'aya hetsiemieme 'aixɨa manuyɨne nekuxatatɨ. Mɨkɨ Kakaɨyari mɨpaɨ pɨtihekɨata, kenemɨtixeha'eriwa nekatihayewatɨ kepauka nemɨnenenewie neheyemekɨ,
ne'iwawirietɨ nehuye 'aixɨa ke'uyurieni 'uxa'atɨni xehetsɨa nemumiekɨ, xɨka mɨpaɨ tinakekani Kakaɨyari.
Waɨkawa nepɨnewaɨriya nexexeiyamɨtɨ, 'Iyaritsie mieme nemɨtixeminikɨ xemɨtuikariekakɨ,
neta yakɨtɨtɨ xehamatɨa nemɨnewaɨriyanikɨ yuri xemɨte'eriekɨ xeme, neta yuri nemɨti'eriekɨ.

Ne'iwama mɨpaɨ pɨnetinakenikeyu mɨpaɨ xemɨtemaikakɨ mɨixa kenemɨtinekuha'aritɨwakai xehetsɨa nemɨmiekɨ, tsepa nemɨkapitɨariekai hikɨke. 'Ikwaxi nemɨkaxeiyakɨ xehetsɨa, hipame nuiwarite wahetsɨa nemeixeiya hepaɨ.
Kaneuyeweka nemɨtiwataxatɨanikɨ kɨriyekutsixi yatɨni memɨkakɨriyekutsixi, temaiwawemete yatɨni memɨkatemaiwawe.
'Ayumieme ne'iyari yapɨ'ane nemɨxetaxatɨanikɨ niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne xemeta Xuma xemɨtama.
Nepɨka'itewiya niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne, tɨrɨkariya kanihɨkɨtɨni Kakaɨyari hetsɨa mieme, yunaitɨ yuri memɨte'erie memɨtawikweitsitɨarienikɨ kani'ayumiemetɨni, huriyutsixi meri, kɨriyekutsixi meta.

Xɨka yuri ti'erieka, mɨkɨ niukitsie kanimatsiɨkɨkamɨkɨ Kakaɨyari heitserie kemɨtiyupitɨwa, para yuri mɨti'eriekakɨ, kemɨre'uxa: «Kemɨ'ane heitseriemekɨ yamɨtikamie, mɨkɨ kanayenierekamɨkɨ yuri mɨti'eriekɨ».
Teɨteri wahetsie kemɨrahɨiwa

Matsi haxɨa kanimatsiɨkɨni, Kakaɨyari taheima makawe kemɨtiheka naime teɨteri kememɨteyurie mekaheyexeiyatɨ heitseriemekɨ yamekatekahutɨ, mɨkɨ memɨka'ihekɨata tita yuri mɨraine heitseriemekɨ yamekatekahutɨ.
Tita mɨtiyɨwe mɨtimaika Kakaɨyari hepaɨtsita, mɨkɨ kanimatsiɨkɨni wahetsɨa, Kakaɨyari yakatiniwaruxeiyatsitɨani.

Kwie munetɨarietsie paitɨ hikɨke, tita mɨkatixeiyariewe hepaɨtsitana, yuheyemekɨ kemɨtitɨrɨkaɨye kemɨtikakaɨyari, mɨkɨ katinihekɨaka metimatiwakɨ tita mɨtiutiwewi hepaɨtsita. 'Ayumieme 'atsimepɨkateyɨwawe yuhetsiemieme memɨtiniunikɨ.

Kakaɨyari mehetimaika, 'aixɨa mepɨka'utiyuanekai hepaɨtsitana Kakaɨyari hepaɨtsita temutiyuane hepaɨ. Pamɨpariyutsi mepɨka'ipitɨakai, matsi yakɨ metekuxatatɨ mekanakɨne mexi niuki mexɨatɨakai, wa'iyari 'atsikatimaiwekaku, kaniukuyɨre wa'iyaritsie.
Temaiwawemete meyuxatatɨ 'atsimekatemaiwawetɨ mekanakɨne.
Kakaɨyari mɨkapɨniwe witsimɨ'ane, mekanipata tewi mɨpɨniwe hepaɨ tiyuxexeiyame memayexeiyanikɨ pɨta, wikixi wahepaɨ, yeutari wahepaɨ meta kuterixi wahepaɨ tiyuxexeiyame.
'Ayumieme Kakaɨyari kaniwayetuani yu'iyaritsie mete'ukahiwe'eriekaku, para meka'itiyatɨ memakɨnekɨ, memitsewiximanikɨ yuwaiyari hipame wahamatɨa.

Kakaɨyari yuri kemaine, mɨkɨ mekanipata 'itarika memexeiyanikɨ pɨta. Tita mɨtiwewiya mepayexeiyakai, hetsiena mieme mepɨte'uximayatakai, mekaheyexeiyatɨ kemɨ'ane mitiwewi. 'Aixɨa yemekɨ ketikɨhɨawarɨwani mɨkɨ yuheyemekɨ, mɨpaɨ xeikɨa kani'aneni.
'Ayumieme Kakaɨyari kaniwayetuani memihiwe'eriekakɨ tita mɨtitewiyɨkɨ. 'Ukariri me'iku'eirieka tita 'ukari memɨteyuruwa, 'uka hepaɨ mekateyurietɨ mepakɨ.

'Ukitsi meta yaxeikɨa me'iku'eirieka 'ukari memɨwakumaɨwanikɨ, mepɨyutaiyakai meyuhiwe'erietɨ, 'ukitsi 'ukitsi wahamatɨa yamepɨteyuriekai kemɨtitewiyɨkɨ. Yuwaiyaritsie mieme mepɨte'akapitɨarie kemɨreuyewekai mɨyamete'uyurieka.
Mɨpaɨ memɨkateku'eriwakaikɨ kename 'aixɨa 'ane Kakaɨyari ma'eriwanikɨ, 'ayumieme Kakaɨyari kaniwayetuani kemɨkatinake yamemɨteku'eriwanikɨ, kemɨkatinake memɨteyuriekakɨ.

Mekanaye'axɨani kemɨkatiheitserie meyɨatɨ, mewakumaɨwatɨ kemɨ'ane mɨkayɨ'ɨya meta mɨkayɨkɨna, 'axametekuyuruwatɨ, naime metehiwe'erietɨ, 'axamete'u'iyaritɨ. Mekanihɨpɨnekaitɨni me'ɨtetsatɨ, meyukwitɨ, meha'atɨ, meteyu'irɨwiyatɨ, niuki peraixi memɨhɨkɨtɨkaikɨ.

'Awie niuki mekaniwewieka, mekaniniukixieka, Kakaɨyari mekani'uxieka, mekatenitawe'erieka naime, mekananuyehaitɨrɨweni, mekateniyukatawe'erieka, mekatenikuwautɨweni 'axakemɨtiuyurienikɨ, yupaapama mepɨkawa'enie.
Yu'iyari mepɨka'enie warutate'akaku, yamepɨkatekahu kememutiyuane, mepɨtsetse'i, mepɨkayunɨtɨarinɨa, mepɨkateyukanenimaya.

Mɨkɨ metehetimaika tita Kakaɨyari mɨtixata tiheitserietɨme, kename yunaitɨ mɨya memɨteyurie wahetsie tinake memɨkwinikɨ 'utaitɨ, mɨkɨ matsi mɨya mekateniyurieka, matsipaitɨ mekaninaki'aka hipatɨ mɨpaɨ meteyuriekaku.
